background: Clarence V. Thomas is a Fremont County commissioner representing District 1, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. The official commissioners page and elected officials directory list him in that office. He lost the August 18, 2026, Republican primary to David Mossburg. Incoming commissioner Nicole A. Wagon, an Independent who defeated Mossburg in the November general election, takes office in January 2027.
